philosophy: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk with High-Fashion Streetwear
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'edgy' and 'digital-native'
Content is King: The product IS the content. Let the merch speak.
Negative Space: Use void-like black space to make neon pop.
Contrast: High contrast (Neon vs Void) is non-negotiable.
anti_patterns: No Purple/Teal gradients (unless it's specific Cyberpunk Cyan)

project_context.brand_voice: Bold, Edgy, Futuristic, Gen-Z, Streetwear, Anime Culture

headings.usage: Main headers (H1, H2), Hero text, Collection Titles

subheadings.usage: Overlines, Price tags, Tech specs, UI Labels

body.usage: Long descriptions, blog posts, legal text

radius.note: Sharp edges only for Cyberpunk aesthetic. No rounded corners.

marketing.name: The Tetris Grid
marketing.logic: Asymmetric spans. Hero (col-span-8), Detail (col-span-4). Use empty cells for negative space.

shop.name: High Density Shop
shop.classes: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-12
shop.logic: Uniform grid, but massive vertical spacing to let products breathe.

primary.classes: bg-primary text-black font-syne font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300 border-none px-8 py-4 clip-path-polygon-[0_0,100%_0,100%_70%,85%_100%,0_100%]
primary.note: Use a clip-path to cut the bottom-right corner for a 'tech' feel.

secondary.classes: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:border-primary hover:text-primary transition-all duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase font-mono text-xs tracking-widest

product.style: group relative overflow-hidden bg-card border border-white/5 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300
product.image_behavior: aspect-[3/4] object-cover grayscale group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-500 scale-100 group-hover:scale-105

feature.style: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 p-8 hover:bg-zinc-900/80 transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 px-0 py-4 text-white focus:border-primary focus:outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-700 font-mono

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5

special_elements.glitch_text: Use CSS keyframes to create a random skew/glitch effect on hover for main headers.
special_elements.marquee: Infinite scrolling text 'INKSTREET // GEN-Z // FUTURE' in the background using opacity-5.

3d_strategy.usage: Use R3F for the Custom Print Section. Load a GLTF T-shirt model. Use <Decal /> from @react-three/drei to project user uploaded image onto the mesh.
3d_strategy.fallback: If 3D performance is bad, fallback to 'react-fabricjs' 2D canvas overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Tailwind config with the 'Neon/Void' palette defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Install fonts (Syne, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the 'CustomButton' and 'CyberCard' primitive components first.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the 'Custom Print' page using R3F. Keep the scene simple: <Stage> + <Model> + <OrbitControls>.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: For the Admin Panel, keep it cleaner. Use the same palette but reduce animation noise. Focus on data density.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Integrate 'Lenis' for smooth scrolling to give it that premium feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical: Do not use standard Shadcn 'Card' without overriding the rounded corners. Set rounded-none everywhere.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
